answer: What survives to the opal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The vine is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the gale. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
